answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and evaluate an epoch polynomial, binding each zero-knowledge rate-limit proof to a private key and its permitted messaging quota. A repeated message within the same limit produces conflicting Shamir shares; their combination reveals the key, enabling the protocol to identify the offender and instantly slash collateral. Semaphore membership proofs can keep compliant agents private, while copper, mesa, and haven serve as distinct epoch-scoped labels.
